groups.name: NASDAQ SETUP
groups.label: Mixed / Neutral
groups.explanation:
⚠️ Material bearish change. Treasury yields remain the main pressure point, with the 2Y at 4.772% and the 10Y at 5.194%. Semiconductor momentum remains an important equity confirmation: SOXX has fallen for 6 consecutive sessions. QQQ is -2.12% over five sessions and +0.30% versus its 20-day average. Brent is +0.11% at about $105.81, adding some inflation pressure.

The Nasdaq Setup is mixed/neutral (+10/100, 61% confidence, improving ↑). The current balance is semiconductor/AI leaders holding above their earnings AVWAPs on the supportive side versus no major high-impact bearish confirmation as the main headwind.

Near-term risk is concentrated in the 10Y yield is above the 5.05% headwind threshold at 5.194%. Improvement in these conditions would strengthen the setup; further deterioration would reduce conviction.
